messages:
mira_finance: Quick kick-off for a tiny pricing experiment (label: micro-rate-labs). Goal: tweak embedding unit price by -2% for a subset and shift monthly credit buckets for dev teams. Proposed go-live 2026-08-10 09:00 UTC. Need invoice-preview, grandfathering rules, and exception handling.

miguel_billing: Please publish cohort filter (plan IDs + excludes). I also request a new invoice-line field `experiment_id` to make reconciliation simpler.

jon_sales: Exclude negotiated contracts and customers tagged `enterprise` or `legal-exempt`. I'll pull AM-owned list and flag any accounts needing outreach.

sophie_legal: Confirm exclusion criteria. I'll prepare legal-approved comms with explicit "no retroactive charges" language. Expect draft by Wed EOD.

tara_ops: Staging SQL to validate cohort:
```sql
SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.plan_id, c.tags
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.next_billing_date BETWEEN '2026-08-10' AND '2026-09-07'
  AND c.tags NOT LIKE '%enterprise%'
  AND c.negotiated = false;
```
I'll run in staging and upload CSV to /finance-drive.

billing-bot: billing-bot: invoice-preview queued for cohort micro-rate-labs (sample 60).

miguel_billing: Running preview locally: `./tools/invoice-preview --cohort micro-rate-labs --sample 60`. Will post link when complete.

billing-bot: invoice-preview complete  60 samples uploaded: https://redir.company/samples/micro-rate-labs-preview.csv

miguel_billing: Preview shows 4 subs with manual rate overrides and 2 with legacy promo credits. Propose we mark overrides as `manual-grandfather` and issue one-off credits for promo gaps. Need sign-off on credit calc method (pro-rate remaining billing period).

mira_finance: OK to use one-off credits for promo mismatches. Miguel, prepare an exceptions sheet with proposed credit amounts and short rationale. We'll review on the preflight call.

tara_ops: Ops note: rate mapping needs an entry `micro_rate_labs` -> `RC_MICRO_2026`. I'll open a PR in payments-service and include a dry-run: `make billing-migrate COHORT=micro-rate-labs DRY_RUN=1`. PR will include rollback steps.

jon_sales: I'll coordinate AM outreach for flagged accounts and post the comms draft to #marketing once Sophie clears it. Timeline looks fine.

mira_finance: Canary plan: 5% invoice volume first 24h -> 25% days 2-4 -> full at day 6 if metrics OK. Rollback triggers: >4% revenue delta in 24h, >1% increase in billing tickets, or any contract dispute. Preflight scheduled 2026-08-07 16:00 UTC. Action owners: Miguel run staging query by 2026-07-31, Sophie comms by 2026-08-05, Tara PR + dry-run by 2026-08-03.

jon_sales: Thanks all, will update AMs when CSV is up. :white_check_mark:
